title: DDWG Generator Boxes
description_text: This Request for Quotation (RFQ) is being issued to establish a firm-fixed-price (FFP) purchase order for Generator Boxes at DLA Distribution Warner Robins (DDWG). The Government intends to award one (1) contract as a result of this RFQ and will be issued on a Standard Form (SF) 1449. This acquisition is not a Defense Priorities and Allocations System (DPAS) rated procurement.
